brand.name: Rangisha.com
brand.sloganSub: Urwego rwo mu Rwanda rwo gutangaza, gushakisha no kugarura ibintu byatakaye cyangwa byatoraguwe mu buryo bwizewe kandi bwemewe.

hero.title: Wabuze ikintu cyangwa hari icyo watoraguye mu Rwanda?
hero.subtitle: Rangisha.com igufasha gutangaza, gushakisha no kugarura ibyawe byabuze. Duhuza uwabuze n'uwatoraguye binyuze mu mucyo no kwizera.
hero.searchPlaceholder: Shakisha ikintu wabuze (urugero: Indangamuntu, iPhone, Ikofi, Musanze...)

categories.title: Ibyiciro By'Ibintu Byakunze Gutakara
categories.subtitle: Hitamo icyiciro cy'ikintu ushakisha cyangwa ushaka gutangaza

howItWorks.title: Uko Rangisha.com Ikora
howItWorks.subtitle: Intambwe eshatu gusa zo kugarura ibintu byawe
howItWorks.step1Desc: Andika ibisobanuro by'ikintu watakaje cyangwa watoraguye: ifoto, aho cyabereye n'ibiranga.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Ikoranabuhanga ryacu riguhuza n'uwabonye ikintu cyawe cyangwa uwagitakaje.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Nyuma yo gusuzuma ibiranga nyiracyo n'ubuyobozi bwa Rangisha, ikintu gisubizwa nyiracyo mu mutekano.

items.reportSuspicious: Tanga Impuruza ku Kintu Gifite Amakenga
items.emptyState: Nta kintu kibonetse gihuye n'ibyo ushakishije. Gerageza guhindura amagambo cyangwa tangaza raporo nshya.

reportForms.lostSub: Uzuza imyirondoro y'ikintu cyawe kugira ngo uwagitoraguye cyangwa ubuyobozi bugufashe kugibona.
reportForms.foundSub: Murakoze ku bunyangamugayo bwanyu. Uzuza amakuru y'icyo watoraguye kugira ngo tugisubize nyiracyo.
reportForms.itemNamePlaceholder: urugero: Indangamuntu ya Mugisha Jean / iPhone 13 Pro
reportForms.landmark: Ahantu hazwi hafi yaho (Aka gare, isoko, urusengero...)
reportForms.photosHelp: Ongeraho ifoto ifatika y'ikintu cyangwa ibisa nacyo (Ntarengwa 5MB).
reportForms.rewardHelp: Igihembo cyongera ubushake bwo gusubiza ikintu (Rangisha ifata komisiyo nto y'ubuyobozi).
reportForms.privacyNotice: Umwirondoro wawe w'ibanga (telefone, imeli) ntushyirwa ku mugaragaro. Rangisha.com yonyine niyo iguhamagara.

recovery.modalSub: Uzuza ibimenyetso bishingira ko iki kintu ari icyawe by'ukuri.
recovery.explanation: Sobanura uburyo ari icyawe n'uko cyagutakayeho
recovery.proof: Ibindi biranga by'ibanga utagaragaje ku mugaragaro (kode, password, ibintu byari birimo)
recovery.successMessage: Icyifuzo cyo kugarura cyoherejwe neza kuri Admin na Finder!

commission.title: Gucunga Imbonerahamwe y'Ibihembo & Komisiyo
commission.feeNotice: Amafaranga yose agaragazwa mu buryo bweruye mbere y'uko ihererekanya riba.

safety.title: Umutekano n'Ubwirinzi kuri Rangisha.com
safety.subtitle: Kugira ngo ugaruze ikintu cyawe mu mutekano busesuye, kurikiza amabwiriza akurikira:
safety.rule1: Ntagushyira hanze amakuru y'ibanga nka PIN za telefone cyangwa amakarita ya banki.
safety.rule2: Ntukohereze amafaranga y'igihembo mbere y'uko uhabwa ikintu cyangwa Rangisha ibyemeza.
safety.rule3: Guhurira ahantu hazwi kandi hari abantu benshi (urugero: kuri Station ya Polisi cyangwa ku Biro by'Umurenge).
safety.rule4: Rangisha.com ikoresha abakozi b'ubuyobozi bagenzura ibimenyetso by'ubunyiracyo mbere yo guhuza abantu.

footer.desc: Rangisha.com ni urubuga rw'igihugu rw'u Rwanda rwashyiriweho gufasha Abanyarwanda kubona no kugarura ibintu byabo byatakaye mu mutekano n'umucyo.
